messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — noticed an odd case in prod where we kept redacted snippets visible in the console for 7 days. Is that the intended 'reveal-window' behavior? Asking because it leaks user-entered PII longer than our retention intention.
ryan.k: that shouldn't be 7 days. where did you see it?
ajulia_ops: @maria.g can you paste the request id?
maria.g: req=01H8Z9-ff33. quick snippet: console shows `***REDACTED***` but the hover-reveal shows actual value until TTL expires. seems TTL was set to 604800s in the route config.
alice.w: 604800s = 7d. that value came from legacy debug policy. we migrated some routes but missed this flag.
ryan.k: ugh. is this the `reveal_window_seconds` in routing v2?
maria.g: yep. sample config: ```json
{"route": "/chat", "reveal_window_seconds": 604800, "sampling": {"type":"bounded","rate":0.01}}
```
ajulia_ops: proposal: clamp any `reveal_window_seconds` > 86400 to 3600 for production by default, unless explicitly allowlisted via enterprise policy. thoughts? :thinking_face: 
alice.w: I like clamping as a safety net. makes accidental long windows less likely. but need a migration plan for Dedicated customers who requested longer windows.
ryan.k: agreed. two steps: 1) platform enforces a safety clamp by default 2) allowlist flow for explicit opt-in w/ audit ticket + SLA.
sam_bot: deploy-check: created migration PR #4321 to clamp reveal windows >86400 to 3600 in runtime router. CI green.
maria.g: thanks. one more nuance — the console still caches the full plaintext in the browser devtools when inspect-mode is used. we should ensure client-side JS strips plaintext from devtools console logs.
alice.w: good catch. frontend should never log plaintext to console. I'll add lint rule to catch `console.log` usages in that path.
ryan.k: operational concern — clamping will increase requests to canary inspection flow (more small unredacts). we should add a short ramp: 100% clamp for non-enterprise routes, 50% for enterprise by default for 24h, then full unless a ticket. add quota bump monitoring.
ajulia_ops: noted. I'll create a dashboard tile: `reveal_window_rate` + `inspect_requests_per_minute` and alert if > 2x baseline.
maria.g: final ask — update docs + the SDK flag name. replace `reveal_window_seconds` with `transient_visibility_sec` and mark old name deprecated. keeps intent clearer.
alice.w: +1 on rename. I'll send the deprecation email and a short migration script.
ryan.k: ok actionable items: - platform: clamp and PR (#4321) - ops: dashboard + alert - frontend: remove devtools plaintext logs - docs: rename + migration email - sales/ent: allowlist + audit process
maria.g: thanks all. I'll follow up with the request id and quick runbook for oncall. :thumbsup:
